Visitor formats definition lists with custom templates

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const _testVisitor = {
    visitDefinitionDescription(ctx: any, text: any): string | { type: "custom"; output: string } {
        return { type: "custom", output: `> ${text}` };
    },

    visitDefinitionTerm(ctx: any, text: any): string | { type: "custom"; output: string } {
        return { type: "custom", output: `### ${text}` };
    },

    }

  const result = convert("<dl><dt>Python</dt><dd>A high-level programming language</dd><dt>JavaScript</dt><dd>A scripting language for web browsers</dd></dl>", { visitor: _testVisitor as any });
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
